jobs.title: Content Creator
jobs.description: For the creatively obsessed. You know that feeling when you've got a great idea and just need to make it happen? No endless planning, no overthinking. Just good creative instincts, a few clever tools and the skills to pull it off. That’s the energy we’re after. We're looking for a Content Creator who genuinely loves making things. Someone with great taste, a head full of ideas and the skills to bring them to life. Someone who's just as comfortable behind the camera as they are in front of it, and has the personality to make people want to watch. And the best part? You'll be creating content for people just like you. A little about us. At Envato , we're all about helping creative professionals do their best work. We're an all-in-one creative asset toolkit bringing together world-class stock assets, purpose-built AI tools for creatives need to bring their ideas to life. Our world is full of designers, filmmakers, editors and creators who love what they do. People who are always looking for the next tool, technique or idea to make their work better. That's who you'll be talking to. Your people. What's the gig? You'll be one of the faces of Envato, concepting, making and starring in content that brings our products to life. Think clever product demos, creative experiments, social videos, tutorials that don't feel like tutorials and content that makes other creatives think,”I need that in my toolkit”. You'll own the whole creative process, from the first idea to the final edit. Writing, filming, presenting, editing and using the latest creative tools, including AI. Some days you'll be showing off a new product feature. Others you'll be experimenting with a new technique or finding a fresh way to tell a story. We're not looking for someone to just churn out content. We want someone who cares about making genuinely good work. Content that entertains, inspires and helps other creatives make something better. jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.description: Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics. The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour). Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know): Health & beauty Fitness Home Decor Fashion Sports Do it yourself Finance Legal Medical Family/Parenting Relationships Real Estate Restaurants Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.) These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover. Requirements : We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff Note : Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.
